correctness.rationale: The isometry f→z1f identifies the full-ball weighted space with the radial Bergman hyperplane-vanishing subspace, whose orthogonal complement is exactly the t-degree-zero monomial sector. Subtracting its kernel gives the displayed quotient and its nonzero t=0 extension. Cauchy–Schwarz gives |q|<1 and every |q|<1 is attainable. The principal Log restricts integers to |j|<s/4; the strict unit-disc root condition reduces to 0<6|j|<s, giving all roots, simplicity, the ceil count and sharp threshold. Strict boundaries s=6m are checked.
